scope: Source-flower restoration preflight for the full-length flower pose rig
summary: The v28 source-flower masks, GrabCut, and SLIC preflights recovered only fragments of the handheld bouquet and mixed in ribbons, plants, face, or hand pixels, so no video was promoted.
evidence: assets/frame0-aligned-person-flower-masks.jpg shows scene ribbons/plants and only fragments of the held bouquet.
assets/grabcut-bouquet-preflight.jpg and assets/slic-bouquet-v2-preflight.jpg show incomplete recall and human/scene contamination.
No final video was rendered from this rejected segmentation route.
lessons: Exact source-pixel restoration metrics are meaningless when the semantic mask omits most of the manipulated object.
A complete-object visual-recall gate must precede long-video integration.
limitations: This attempt ended at segmentation preflight.
next_actions: Create a complete bouquet-only RGBA asset and bind it to the hand trajectory as an independent semantic layer.
